name: Dragon Den - Euphoria
teaser: Euphoria opens the Dragon Den with 120+ items and a 52 quest run. Jobs range from quick to tough. Stock includes backpacks, sights, silencers, containers, and more.
description:
Overview

Requires
WTT-CommonLib

What you get

  • New trader: Euphoria (quest unlocked)
  • 120+ custom items across practical categories
  • 52 quest storyline that progresses cleanly from intro to finish
  • Therapist intro and a late Mechanic task
  • Secure container craft in hideout
  • All of the items in the Items page spawn in raid (except secure container and containers)

Getting started with quests

  • Accept Whispers Through Shattered Glass from Therapist to unlock Euphoria
  • Follow a straight chain with supply runs, reliability checks, quiet deliveries and rewards
  • After Bad Habit, pick up Vapor Substitute from Mechanic
  • Rewards are various barter items, bullets, mags, guns, etc..
Trader

Anya “Euphoria” Zaytseva

Anya grew up around noise and cheap tools. If something closed right and held, she trusted it. When Norvinsk locked down, she stayed. She watched what people carried, what failed, and what they were willing to pay for when things got rough.

She took over a small signal shack by the rail, painted the door black, and started calling it the Dragon Den. Inside is simple and tidy. Pegboard with straps and buckles. Racks for rifles that actually run. Backpacks stacked by fit, not fashion. A small case for valuables that do not scream their price. Then there is the shelf she pretends is just barter. Cat paw zipper pulls, bright sling keepers, small charms, sticker sheets. She rolls her eyes when you point at it, then restocks it anyway.

She is new to contracting. No speeches, no sob stories. You say what you need, you pay clean, you leave on time. She deals in equipment that works, weapons that cycle, packs that do not quit, valuables that travel quiet, and the odd cute thing that makes a bad day lighter. She does not patch wounds and she does not promise miracles.
Therapist is the one person she will change plans for. They argue, then they sort it, and neither one wastes words. People come to Euphoria for straight deals and leave with gear that fits and a pack that will not betray them. At closing she lines up the next day’s crates, writes names on tape, and locks the door. If you ask why she keeps at it, she says, “Good gear should be easy to buy,” and gets back to work.

Items

Categories
Backpacks, Valuables, Buttstocks, Containers, Facewear, Foregrips, Helmets, Muzzles, Sights, Silencers, Secure Containers, Quest items

(Image Quality is not good)

Quests
  • Therapist intro
    Whispers Through Shattered Glass
    • In Terragroup building next to Mechanics locked door, it’s on butchering table seen in quest image.
  • Mechanic follow up
    Vapor Substitute after Bad Habit
  • Euphoria storyline
    50 quests in a single linear chain with some side quests
Installation

Unpack the zip and drop the user folder into your SPTarkov root.

(Use 7Zip Here)

Install demo video credit to Drakia:

Recommended Mods

Recommended Mods:

  • Dragon Den - Neon Signs
  • Dynamic Maps (for quest locations)
  • Kaeno Traderscrolling
Known Issues
  • Not compatible with SPT Realism as is (i will not make a patch)
  • Other than that, none that I know of.
Credits
  • Welcome to Tarkov for framework and help
  • EpicRangeTime for helping me a lot with weapon parts!
  • Drakia for the install video
What is Dragon Den

Dragon Den is my twist on Tarkov. It is where cuteness, edgyness, and weirdness collide while staying believable.

  • Traders with their own quirks and attitude
  • Custom items and quests that feel fresh
  • Backpacks, armor, facewear and headwear with personality
  • Odd creations that should not exist but still fit right in

No weapons, just everything else that makes Tarkov less boring.

Want to reach me? Look for #drexiras-dragon-den in Welcome To Tarkov’s Discord

dependencies.name: WTT - CommonLib
dependencies.teaser: A modding utility library that eliminates boilerplate when adding custom items, quests, characters, and more to SPT

versions.description:
• added support for nested folders for quest locales
  • added support for multiple crafts per file

Fixed more gameworld.mainplayer references for fika headless compatibility Added packet delivery system for static spawns for fika compatibility

This version works for fika and spt, it only loads the fika helper assembly if fika is present. This should hopefully fix the last issues for headless crashing on raid start, but if there are still issues let me know!
• fixes headless crash when using fika. ONLY NEEDED FOR FIKA HEADLESS USERS

• added customachievementservice & modslot helpers
  • removed debug lines causing confusion when locales/questdata weren’t present
  • fixed a major issue with customassortservice adding multiple mods assorts multiple times /bonk

• added new helper method for customitemserviceextended for secure filters
  • added missing properties to clothing configs for questrequirements and achievementrequirements (skillrequirements will have to wait until next major SPT verison)
  • fixed side locked quests not working properly /bonk
  • added buyrestrictionmax for trader barters in customitemserviceextended
  • added new customaudioservice for facecard and radio audio
  • renamed customprofileservice method from add to create for consistency

SPT-4.0 Release

  • Added Quest Hints on Wiki Page
  • Fixed various quests, tested and confirmed all works.

dependencies.name: Virtual's Custom Quest Loader
dependencies.teaser: A dependency that imports quests, images, zones and language files into the game with additional quest creation features and a zone GUI tool.

versions.description:
SPT 3.11

Changes

  • Updated to 3.11

SPT 3.10

Changes

  • Updated to 3.10

SPT 3.9.x

Changes

  • Changed the way rotations are stored. They are now actually used when zones are created. Any zone with existing rotation values will need to be added back into the GUI editor and redone.
  • Updated to 3.9.x

SPT-AKI 3.8.1, 3.8.2, 3.8.3

Additions

  • Added a new option to the GUI Zone creation tool - Any Zones added by the loader can now be loaded back into the creation tool. This should assist modders with altering, fixing or viewing their already existing zones.

(If you downloaded this and it had issues extracting, it’s because it was compressed with 7zip and the windows extraction tool doesn’t like it. I have fixed the download zip to counter this)

SPT-AKI 3.8.0

Additions

  • The biggest one - VCQL now includes a client mod. This is for custom zones, with an included GUI tool for zone creation. Mod authors can now create / visualize custom zones for quests like ‘place item’, ‘exploration’, ‘kill in area’, ‘launch flare’ etc.
  • Added zone importing.
  • Added assort importing.
  • Added trader image importing.
  • Added quest date ranges (Thanks to shibdib for the pr).
  • Added Korean locale support.
  • Added a config option to allow all quests, even with a sideExclusive property, to be available to the user.

Changes

  • Changed the side exclusive property away from ‘side’ to ‘sideExclusive’ as it was causing issues with outdated versions.

Massive thanks to the SPT community for helping with this update and a special thanks to the following people in particular:

  • CJ - Supplying the client zone loading code, updated from Boop’s API (Boop goated).
  • Boop - Original author of the Quest Zones API.
  • Groovey - Submitting a PR with the flare zone loading code.
  • Timber - Helping with materials / transparency / collision of unity objects for the tool.
  • And a special thanks to the mod authors who use VCQL and give me feedback!

For a more in-depth view of the update, view the repository where I have more documentation.
Fixed information on the Introduction Quest Whispers Through Shattered Glass as it had old information i forgot to change.
